renkaArchitectural glazing Quotation portal

Prepare a client quotation.

Drop the Logikal estimation and the quote builds itself: positions, sizes, finishes, glass, costs and elevation drawings. Everything runs on this machine; nothing is uploaded.

  1. 01Load the Logikal estimation
  2. 02Add anything Logikal doesn't hold: rooflights, bought-in doors, panels
  3. 03Set the discount and installation, and check the figures
  4. 04Issue the quotation as a PDF, and the working sheet as Excel

Quotation details

Shaded amber cells are your manual overrides — they survive re-loading a revised estimation. Use ↺ on a row to put it back to the calculated values. Frame cost = (material + wages + extras) from Logikal, glass cost = Logikal glass, both with the uplift and rounding set in Pricing & rules.

Extras — things that are not in the Logikal file

Rooflights, bought-in doors, extra glass panels… Click what you want to add, then fill in the yellow boxes. The customer price works itself out.

Product rules

First matching rule wins. System contains is matched against the Logikal system name. Type: “fixed” = no hardware in the estimate. Blank man days = automatic (0.5 single pane, 0.75 two panes, +0.5 per extra pane).

Extras list (products not in Logikal)

These appear under + Add extras. Markup, cill, man days and wording fill in automatically — you only type the cost.
